$comment: Hand-tuned seeds for tools/overlay/catalogue_g20.py (package E). measure: the rect, ROI and signal the geometry comes from. states: {photo: [lit, colour, note]} read by eye on the rects (lit null = the spot is covered or unreadable; not lit is NOT evidence that BMW does not draw it). notes carry relation hints for package F; relation/evidence/basis stay unknown/none/[] here.

08.note: Stock theme at night just after start-up: the most lamps lit, the check-control 'ready to drive' panel, map, 50 sign. Master inventory for E.

09.note: Stock theme by day, driving (gear D), map with a roundabout; no warnings lit.

10.note: Our transparent calibration grid (labels, L1-L16, grey ramps, ATLAS text) over the stock theme; BMW's black box and bottom-row P are drawn. Grid labels hide some spots.

11.note: Our early opaque theme (old geometry, before bc2fc0d's G20 fit; exact build unknown). B's fit points only reach y 562, below that the rect is extrapolated.

12.note: Our opaque theme at night (B used the cb28ce7 bench render for alignment); BMW's red (P), belt, P and black box drawn over us.

13.note: Our baked theme on the car, same session as 12 (B used cb28ce7); very coarse: visual checks only.

14.note: Our 0.7.2 connected but only our text layers drew (unbound-sampler bug, fixed in 0.7.3): the stock theme is visible beneath our text. Coarse: centres good, edges blur over ~5 px.

excluded.what: Low-beam headlight lamp (green) and side/parking-light lamp (green), left of the panel
excluded.reason: Physical LED telltales in the housing, not on the TFT: photo 08's model maps them to panel x ~ -90, y ~ 555 and 602 (outside 1920x720). No theme can draw over or hide them.

excluded.what: Check-engine lamp (amber) and DSC OFF lamp (amber), right of the panel
excluded.reason: Physical LED telltales in the housing: photo 08's model maps them to panel x ~ 2000-2008, y ~ 550 and 614 (outside the panel).

excluded.what: Individual speedo/tacho numerals, ticks, the red gradient band inside the bezels, the dark dial wings and the orange needle glow
excluded.reason: Part of the stock dials; catalogued only as ghost outlines (structure.speedo, structure.tacho, needles, rev band, minis) because they are context, not indicators.

excluded.what: Individual map roads, the roundabout (09) and the lighter map background seen in 14
excluded.reason: Covered by the single map.region polygon (hull of all road pixels in 08, 09, 14 plus C9's hull).

excluded.what: READY, OFF (centre-right, ~1290-1340 x 450-545), the clocks 08:16 / 20:29 / 14:29, the Time/Range/Temp block, our numerals, our '1/min x 1000', our range '456 km' near the speedo, our minis, needles, map window and the l/100 km mini in photos 11-14
excluded.reason: Our own widgets (6WB theme), not G20 elements; they are in design/overlay/wb_comfort.json.

excluded.what: The calibration grid in 10: green lines, yellow coordinate labels, L1-L16, 'ATLAS 14:29 950', the grey ramps
excluded.reason: Our test layout (grid.json), drawn transparent over the stock theme for photo 10.

excluded.what: Glass reflections, the hood shadow and the housing outside the TFT
excluded.reason: Not drawn by the cluster (see docs/BAKE-C9-overlays.md section 1).
